sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: n8n is a workflow automation platform for building AI agents and automations. You connect steps on a visual canvas, add JavaScript or Python where you need it, and link to 1,500+ apps and services. You can self-host it or use n8n Cloud.
sixtySeconds.problem: Automating work across many apps, or building AI agents that use your data and tools, normally means writing and hosting lots of glue code. n8n gives you a visual builder with ready-made integrations and templates while still letting you write code.
whoFor: Developers building AI agents and multi-step workflows
Operations and marketing people connecting their tools
Companies that need self-hosted automation for sensitive data
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for self-hostable automation with deep AI support and a huge integration library. Note it's fair-code under the Sustainable Use License, not an OSI open-source license.
requirements: A browser to use the editor

overview: n8n combines a visual workflow canvas with custom code. Workflows can include AI steps using OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or open-source models, with tool use, human approvals and observability, and you can switch model providers without rebuilding.
It ships 1,500+ integrations and 9,000+ workflow templates, and supports JavaScript, Python and npm packages for advanced logic. Enterprise features include role-based access and audit trails.

The quickest start is the install script, which requires Docker, or a docker run command that stores data in a Docker volume. The editor opens at http://localhost:5678. n8n is distributed under the Sustainable Use License and the n8n Enterprise License.
